name: Stoppage by the employer’s fault — full contract wage

pay.name: Work suspension pay adjustment
pay.rate: sum(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK").map(d, max(0.0, (terms.base_salary / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))) - d.suspended.pay)))

references.title: Labour Code art.99(1); counted service, Decree 145/2020 art.65(9)

name: Stoppage by the worker’s own fault — unpaid, not counted service
Stoppage by another worker’s fault — agreed wage, at least the regional minimum
rate: day.day_type == "WORK" ? max((terms.base_salary / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))) * (has(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) ? double(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) : (has(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) ? double(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) : 100.0)) / 100.0, (double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region in ["II", "III", "IV"] ? company.region : "I"]) / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days)))) : 0.0

name: Utility failure, natural disaster, fire, epidemic, enemy action, State-ordered relocation or economic reasons — agreed wage, at least the regional minimum for the first 14 working days
rate: day.day_type == "WORK" ? (double(suspension.working_days_elapsed) <= 14.0 ? max((terms.base_salary / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))) * (has(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) ? double(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) : (has(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) ? double(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) : 100.0)) / 100.0, (double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region in ["II", "III", "IV"] ? company.region : "I"]) / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days)))) : (terms.base_salary / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))) * (has(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) ? double(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) : (has(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) ? double(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) : 100.0)) / 100.0) : 0.0
